scripts.font: mkdir -p fonts && curl -L -o fonts/NotoSansDevanagari-700-deva.woff2 https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/noto-sans-devanagari@latest/devanagari-700-normal.woff2 && curl -L -o fonts/NotoSansDevanagari-700-latin.woff2 https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/noto-sans-devanagari@latest/latin-700-normal.woff2
scripts.encode: mkdir -p out && ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i frames/f%05d.png -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/rohan_story.mp4
